name: gtd
description: Getting Things Done: capture into an inbox, triage each item into one bucket (next, waiting, someday, reference, done), projects and a calendar of due days. JSON routes the agent and the page call, and the board as a widget on the first screen. Data in gtd.json in the app's home.
mount: a row `- id: gtd` / `name: gtd` before the server row in blend.yaml

config.store: a GtdStore for tests (default: gtd.json in the app's home)
